A candidate SPL market unit would need a reliable price source and a USDC liquidity path. Listing, custody, jurisdiction, and program permissions require separate review before production.

A production series would need a named feed, market session, fallback behavior, and settlement window. This preview uses local assumptions and performs no oracle reads.

For starting price P0 and cap rate c, K = P0 x (1 + c). At assumed settlement price S, Upside receives max(0, S - K). Income receives value up to K plus any hypothetical auction premium.
Illustrative values. No live quote, custody, signing or execution.
